audience: shift managers and HR staff who plan rosters, timesheets and absences in Shiftbase

useCases.title: See who is scheduled to work, by team and date
useCases.text: The AI lists scheduled shifts for a date range of up to 62 days, with employee, team, shift type, times, hours and cost.

useCases.title: Find open shifts and employee availability
useCases.text: The AI lists open shifts that employees can still pick up and reads employee availability for a date range, so you can fill gaps.

useCases.title: Check worked hours and who is clocked in
useCases.text: The AI lists timesheets with clock in and out, breaks, totals and status, and shows who is clocked in right now with their scheduled shift.

useCases.title: Summarize absences for a period
useCases.text: The AI lists leave, sick leave and other absences with type, dates, hours or days and status, so you see who was absent and for how long.

useCases.title: Schedule a shift or change an existing one
useCases.text: The AI puts an employee on the schedule for one date with a shift type, times and break, or moves a scheduled shift. The employee is notified only if you ask.

useCases.title: Request an absence, or approve or decline one
useCases.text: The AI adds an absence request for an employee, with hours from Shiftbase's own calculation, or approves or declines a pending request.
